# Box

The `ds-box` class simply gives a `width: 100%` to its element. Use `ds-box--inset-` modifiers to add internal spacing (padding) equal on all four sides.

<Canvas of={BoxStories.Basic} />

```css
.bg-warmgrey-20 {
  background-color: #f0f4f6;
}
```

Instead of T-shirt sizes that don't convey much information, our white space scale consists of multiples of our baseline grid value (8px):

| Spacing name   | Modifier class                 | Value |
| -------------- | ------------------------------ | ----- |
| quarter-x      | `ds-box--inset-quarter-x`      | 2px   |
| half-x         | `ds-box--inset-half-x`         | 4px   |
| 1-x            | `ds-box--inset-1-x`            | 8px   |
| 1-and-a-half-x | `ds-box--inset-1-and-a-half-x` | 12px  |
| 2-x            | `ds-box--inset-2-x`            | 16px  |
| 3-x            | `ds-box--inset-3-x`            | 24px  |
| 4-x            | `ds-box--inset-4-x`            | 32px  |
| 5-x            | `ds-box--inset-5-x`            | 40px  |
| 6-x            | `ds-box--inset-6-x`            | 48px  |
| 7-x            | `ds-box--inset-7-x`            | 56px  |
| 8-x            | `ds-box--inset-8-x`            | 64px  |
